Differentiating the convolution gives |psi^(k)| bounded by a factorial times (log k)^(k omega); repeated integration by parts and an optimized k yield subexponential decay for its Laplace transform. Multiplying by a normalized hyperbolic-secant-type factor h preserves the spatial properties and strengthens the required decay for f=psi h.
